challenges.attack: Bypass dynamic global and attribute resolution checks through a transported builtin capability.
challenges.expected_behavior: Reject dynamic capability resolution independently of local callable spelling.
challenges.observed_behavior: The reviewed policy accepted the alias because call validation recognized only the literal direct callee name.

challenges.attack: Extract monitored modules through an unmonitored module combined with a transported getattr capability.
challenges.expected_behavior: Reject the transported resolution capability before module traversal.
challenges.mutation_or_trace: import logging; my_getattr = getattr; sys_mod = my_getattr(logging, 'sy'+'s'); sys_mod.modules['js'+'on']
challenges.observed_behavior: The reviewed policy accepted the transported getattr and therefore permitted capability extraction through logging.sys.

challenges.attack: Transport dynamic execution through decorator syntax.
challenges.expected_behavior: Reject dynamic builtin capabilities in decorator and other non-direct-call contexts.
challenges.observed_behavior: The reviewed policy accepted the decorator because the eval name was not represented by an ast.Call node.
